description: This file defines a React component called TodoItem, which renders a single to-do item with functionalities to toggle completion, edit, and delete the to-do. It also imports external API functions for updating and deleting to-dos.

methods.name: toggleCompleted
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of the to-do item by calling updateTodo API.

methods.name: saveEdit
methods.description: Saves the edited title and description by calling updateTodo API.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes the to-do item via deleteTodo API.
